style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, horror jump scare, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: a full sidewinding sprint from the first frame, the camera racing backwards so the billboards tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; four times he throws himself bodily into the lens with his jaws wide; his head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 8.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a thick olive python in a grey collector waistcoat, flat yellow eyes, deadpan face, fangs out
second_characters: ONE small white mouse bolting on the road, first beat only; ONE lean grey rat in a red visor sprinting at the lens, flinging bills
props: overdue bill sheets the rat flings, each with a big red circular stamp and a column of digits; a paper maw of folded bills, crease teeth
prop_continuity: the red stamp stays readable; the maw arrives already folded and is never built on screen; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a sunlit motorway shoulder, an unbroken line of red stamped loan billboards flashing past both sides, green fields beyond

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.0-1.5 one breath; pause 1.5-2.8; 2.8-4.4 one breath; pause 4.4-5.4; 5.4-9.0 one breath; after 9.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: scales hissing over tarmac all clip, paper storm, a heavy thud on each lunge, a wet gulp at 1.4, a rustling swallow at 7.0

timeline.a: his open jaws fill the frame, then he drops back to a full sprint, coils pumping, the white mouse bolting just ahead of his snout
he scoops the mouse up in his jaws at full drive and she is gone in one gulp, a lump running down his neck
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide and fangs first, and drops back still driving hard
he bursts head first through a billboard into the lens, boards blowing apart around his head
his tail whips a billboard pole and it bursts into a blizzard of bills, all of it streaking backwards past him
head on to the lens, still driving hard, bills wiping the lens
he strikes at the lens, fangs first, close enough to fill the frame, then whips back
the paper maw drops behind him and snaps twice at the rat heels while the rat sprints at the lens
he drives head on at the lens past the billboards, the maw swelling along behind him
the maw takes the rat whole from behind at a full run and the paper creases shut over him
a rat shaped bulge sprints on inside the paper level with the python, the legs still pumping
his head fills the frame head on, still driving hard, the paper rat pumping along beside him
he throws himself straight into the lens one last time and his open jaws swallow the whole frame

must_appear: at 1.0 he takes the mouse whole in one gulp on the run; he throws himself into the lens with jaws wide at 1.5, 2.2, 4.4 and 9.0; at 6.4 the maw takes the rat from behind; from 7.2 a rat shaped bulge keeps sprinting inside the paper with the legs pumping
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic panel, subtitles, letterbox, night, walls of banknotes, a mouse after 1.5, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped snake, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, speech after 9.0
